doc: I81 prereg instrument (BUILD_PLAN row I81 = I44a; whitepaper Def 6.13, Thm 6.8, Thm 6.9, Def 6.20, §10.10, §11.3 Impact column; the contract is the docstring of tests_m3/test_ranking.py). Frozen at the I81 prereg; the build reads it and never edits it. It fixes the policy the ranking applies, never a value: which measure each rule has (Def 6.13), the key a measure waits on when its rule or input does not exist yet, the sink class of each divergence channel, and the order of each ranking dimension (most severe first; the names inside one inner list share a rank). How a channel, a persistence class, a reach kind and a cost are computed from the records, witnesses, replay reports and model documents is the contract's rules K1-K8, PE1-PE3, RE1-RE3 and CO1; nothing here names a law, an action or a target.

order_doc: Sink: the classes §11.3 names, by severity (funds and safety first, an off-chain view last); undecided last. Persistence (§10.10: discharge profiles feed it; a mixed profile ranks below a non-dischargeable one): a pure-function defect (code) and a non-dischargeable guard persist until the code changes; an undecided class ranks right below them, since it may be either; then the classes a principal can discharge, the self-dischargeable last. Reach: the obstruction reachable by anyone first; an undecided or pending reach right below it (it may be anyone's); then by the privilege the witness needs, the most privileged last. Cost: fewer calls first; an unknown cost last. Ties: the law id.
